title: NASM IDE
description: Language Server Protocol-based IntelliSense, hover docs, cross-file extern support, library-aware diagnostics, and build tasks for NASM-style x86/x86_64 assembly.

title: BugTrail — Debugging Memory
description: Automatically keeps a searchable timeline of the errors you hit (terminal, debugger, tasks), what you edited while fixing them and what finally worked — and tells you when a bug you already solved comes back, in any project. Understands JS/TS, Python, Java, .NET, Go and IBM i message IDs (CPF, MCH,

title: DevImpact — Change Impact Analyzer
description: Before you change code, see what depends on it, what could break and which tests to run. Works on uncommitted changes, staged changes, branches, files and single functions — for TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Java/Kotlin, Go and IBM i (RPGLE, CL, DDS, SQL).

title: Flotilla
description: Files, search, version control and Claude Code chats for every git worktree, in one window, on the host and in devcontainers.

title: CodePilot-vaibhav-ai
description: AI coding assistant for VS Code: chat with your files, inline edit with diff preview, and searchable chat history. Works with any OpenAI-compatible API.

title: Remote Image Preview
description: Preview remote and CDN images on hover and in the editor gutter, with full SVG theme-color adaptation.

title: UIToSource
description: Right-click any element in your running React or Angular app and jump to — or edit in place — its TypeScript, template/JSX, and CSS. No project changes.

title: DevSuite TraceLens — API Flow Explorer
description: See every API endpoint in your workspace and trace a request through routes, controllers, services and repositories down to database queries and outgoing HTTP calls, without opening every file. Express, NestJS, Fastify, Flask, FastAPI, Django, Spring, ASP.NET and Go.

title: DevSuite CodeGuard — Pre-Commit Risk Scanner
description: A prioritised risk report for your changes before you commit: leaked secrets, injection-prone code, broken imports, removed APIs, missing tests, wide blast radius, risky config and IBM i pitfalls (DDS level checks, hard-coded libraries, MONMSG CPF0000). Optional git pre-commit hook.

title: Pi Agent for VS Code
description: AI coding assistant in VS Code, powered by the local pi agent

title: URScript Language Server
description: URScript language support with full LSP features

title: Kurt
description: The Kurt proof language: each line of a proof checked as you type, with its reason, errors and todos at their lines, completion, and hover with the certificate.

title: Overstory
description: Overstory: your Claude Code and Codex sessions across every repo and git worktree in a multi-root workspace. Click one to swap only that repo to its worktree and resume the session in a terminal.

title: Agent Standup
description: Watch your Claude Code session as a live, animated team call: the lead gives orders, sub-agents join, share their screen and report back — with voices, a sub-agent tree, timeline, recap and video export.

title: Auto Docs Live
description: Documenta tu código mientras programas: genera comentarios de documentación al guardar y mantiene un documento vivo del proyecto.
